result.title: COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection
result.summary: Generalizable AI-generated image (AIGI) and deepfake detection remain challenging due to the asymmetry phenomenon, where adaptation to limited training distributions can degrade the transferable representations of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Recent subspace adaptation methods mitigate this issue by freezing high-magnitude principal components while adapting the residual subspace. However, such magnitude-based decomposition is data-agnostic and does not explicitly account for target-relevant semantics, potentially leading to semantic misalignment. We propose COMPASS (COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation), a data-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses a small unlabeled Semantic Proxy Set to estimate target activation statistics. COMPASS incorporates activation covariance into the decomposition of pre-trained weights, preserving target-relevant representations as a stable semantic reference while the residual adapter learns forgery-related variations. The proxy calibration requires no gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across cross-dataset, cross-method, joint cross-dataset-method, and open-world cross-generator evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both Deepfake and AIGI detection benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 COMPASS，一种数据感知的子空间适配框架：用小型无标注语义代理集估计目标激活统计，将激活协方差纳入预训练权重分解，冻结目标相关的语义子空间作为稳定参考，再由残差适配器学习伪造相关变化，以提升 AIGI 与 deepfake 检测的跨域泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其依据激活协方差区分「需保留的语义子空间」与「可适配残差」的分解思路，可能为 LVR 中适配模型时保留视觉证据、抑制内部表示信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；但任务本身是图像取证检测，与 VLM 推理状态无直接联系。
